column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row platform/drain. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the controller (the drained server is out of the pool) does not change the pool by the drain in this pass — keeps the previous judgement of the drain, if there was one; otherwise does not count a drain and does not move units; the cause goes to the pass log
the whole row is unreadable: the console (`GET /drain`, N1.2) — a mandatory read is not confirmed, 503 `unavailable` (N4)

revision is unreadable: only the console reads it — the row stays, in the door's answer revision 0, the next write writes 1 (P/06.6 N2.1 «Row revision»); other readers do not read the field and do not reject the row
